findings.title: Low board approval rate for CITCodeInspector: 7% (4/57 proposals acted on)
findings.description: CITCodeInspector has submitted 57 board proposals but only 4 have been approved and implemented (7% rate). Low approval rates may indicate proposals are too vague, too ambitious, or misaligned with the firm's current priorities. This agent should recalibrate its proposal quality standards.
findings.proposed_fix: Review the last 5 unimplemented CITCodeInspector proposals. Are they too abstract? Too large in scope? Not evidence-backed enough? Retask the agent to produce smaller, more actionable proposals.

findings.title: 82% of CIT bug proposals lack precise evidence — quality degradation
findings.description: 221 of 269 BUG_FIX/DATA_QUALITY proposals (82%) have vague evidence strings (no file:line, metric, or data path). VISION/IMPROVEMENT proposals are excluded from this check — they are architectural and don't require code-level evidence.
findings.proposed_fix: Each CIT agent's analyze() method should be reviewed. BUG_FIX findings must include a specific file:line, metric, or data path. VISION/IMPROVEMENT proposals may be qualitative.

findings.title: CITSelfImprovement has 32 approved proposal(s) — verify implementation
findings.description: Previous self-improvement proposals were board-approved but may not have been implemented: ['62% of CIT proposals lack precise evidence — quali', '45% of CIT proposals lack precise evidence — quali', '80% of CIT proposals lack precise evidence — quali']. An approved-but-unimplemented proposal is wasted board attention.
findings.proposed_fix: Director should verify each approved self-improvement proposal has a corresponding code change or process update. Close or reopen as needed.
